```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(knitr)

# Brand palette, matched to styles/theme.scss
pal <- c(
  "Organic search"    = "#6B2737",
  "Paid search (CPC)" = "#C98A9B",
  "Referral"          = "#5E8DB3",
  "Direct"            = "#8A4B5E"
)

theme_portfolio <- function(base = 13) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base) +
    theme(
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      axis.title       = element_text(colour = "#7A6E68"),
      axis.text        = element_text(colour = "#2B2326"),
      legend.position  = "top",
      legend.title     = element_blank()
    )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: data
#| include: false
# Google's public GA4 sample e-commerce dataset (Google Merchandise Store),
# Nov 1, 2020 to Jan 31, 2021, queried in BigQuery and cached as a CSV.
ga4_raw <- read_csv("data/ga4_channel_funnel.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

channel_lookup <- c(
  "organic"  = "Organic search",
  "cpc"      = "Paid search (CPC)",
  "referral" = "Referral",
  "(none)"   = "Direct"
)

ga4 <- ga4_raw |>
  filter(medium %in% names(channel_lookup)) |>
  mutate(
    channel   = unname(channel_lookup[medium]),
    conv_rate = purchased / users
  )

funnel <- ga4 |>
  select(channel, users, viewed_item, added_to_cart, began_checkout, purchased) |>
  pivot_longer(-channel, names_to = "step", values_to = "n") |>
  mutate(step = factor(step,
    levels = c("users", "viewed_item", "added_to_cart", "began_checkout", "purchased"),
    labels = c("Visited", "Viewed item", "Added to cart", "Began checkout", "Purchased"))) |>
  group_by(channel) |>
  mutate(pct = n / max(n)) |>
  ungroup()

total_users      <- sum(ga4_raw$users)
total_purchasers <- sum(ga4_raw$purchased)
overall_cr       <- total_purchasers / total_users
cr_organic <- ga4$conv_rate[ga4$medium == "organic"]
cr_cpc     <- ga4$conv_rate[ga4$medium == "cpc"]

chi_tab <- ga4 |>
  filter(medium %in% c("organic", "cpc")) |>
  transmute(channel, purchased, not_purchased = users - purchased)
chi_mat <- as.matrix(chi_tab[, -1])
rownames(chi_mat) <- chi_tab$channel
chi_res <- chisq.test(chi_mat)
```

## Row {height="78%"}

### Conversion {width="45%"}

```{r}
#| title: Visitor-to-purchase conversion rate by channel
ga4 |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(channel, conv_rate), y = conv_rate, fill = channel)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = percent(conv_rate, 0.01)), hjust = -0.15, size = 4.2,
            colour = "#2B2326") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.25))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Conversion rate") +
  theme_portfolio()
```

### Funnel {width="55%"}

```{r}
#| title: Share of each channel's visitors reaching each funnel step
funnel |>
  ggplot(aes(step, pct, colour = channel, group = channel)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2.6) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = pal) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% of channel visitors") +
  theme_portfolio() +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "#F1EBE1"))
```

# Paid vs. Organic

## Row {height="55%"}

::: {.card title="What the test asks"}
**Analytics Objective (AO4):** Analyze GA4 conversion path data to evaluate whether Google Shopping Ads would improve traffic-to-purchase conversion for the CPP Farm Store.

A chi-square test of independence checks whether purchasing depends on the traffic channel (organic search vs. paid search).

- Chi-square = `{r} round(chi_res$statistic, 2)`, df = `{r} chi_res$parameter`, p = `{r} format.pval(chi_res$p.value, digits = 2)`
- Paid search converted at **`{r} percent(cr_cpc, 0.01)`** vs. **`{r} percent(cr_organic, 0.01)`** for organic search.
:::

::: {.card title="What it means for the Farm Store"}
In this sample store, paid clicks converted **lower** than organic search. Paying for traffic did not automatically produce more buyers, which supports research arguing that trust and perceived value drive purchases from Shopping Ads more than exposure alone.

Before spending on ads, the Farm Store should strengthen organic SEO and measure its own GA4 baseline, then test Shopping Ads in a short, tracked campaign.
:::

## Row {height="45%"}

```{r}
#| title: Purchasers vs. non-purchasers by channel
ga4 |>
  filter(medium %in% c("organic", "cpc")) |>
  transmute(channel,
            Purchased = purchased,
            `Did not purchase` = users - purchased) |>
  pivot_longer(-channel, names_to = "outcome", values_to = "n") |>
  group_by(channel) |>
  mutate(share = n / sum(n)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(outcome == "Purchased") |>
  ggplot(aes(channel, share, fill = channel)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = percent(share, 0.01)), vjust = -0.6, size = 4.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.2))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Share who purchased") +
  theme_portfolio()
```
